name: Ines Carrow
description: A sailor's jumper, too big for her. Keeps glancing at the window.

visits.greeting: Good day. Is it — can you get the weather here? From books?

request.text: A Gardener's Almanac of Small Weathers. My husband sails on the next calm day, and I want to know which day that is.

readThoughts.default: Grey sky over the harbour wall. Which grey?

purpose.1: The weather. For a boat. For a man on a boat.

experience.1: I can read a tide table. That's not the same, is it.

alternative.line: Will this tell me the weather? Then thank you.

declined.line: Oh. I'll watch the gulls, then.

good.text: He sailed on the calm day, as the book said, and came home on the next. Thank you. — Ines
